overview_description.description: Electric is the industry leader in providing world-class IT technology and real-time support for small and mid-sized businesses. With close to 1,000 customers and more than 45,000 employee end-users, Electric's IT platform includes: real-time support powered by 100+ IT technicians, security, device & inventory management, network & server management, application & cloud management, employee on-boarding and off-boarding, procurement & provisioning, and data monitoring & insights.

about_short_description.short_description: Electric provides an IT management platform with security, device management, employee onboarding, and business IT automation tools.

product.name: Electric IT Hub
product.description: A centralized SaaS platform for managing IT and security operations including device, application, and employee lifecycle management.

product.name: Mobile Device Management (MDM)
product.description: A service to manage, monitor, and secure employee devices across MacOS and Windows platforms with remote lock and wipe capabilities.

product.name: Employee Onboarding and Offboarding Automation
product.description: A solution that automates employee lifecycle management by integrating with HR systems to provision and deprovision devices and applications.

product.name: Device Procurement and Provisioning
product.description: A service that handles purchasing, shipping, provisioning, and lifecycle management of new or used devices and peripherals for employees.

product.name: Gigawatt AI-Powered IT Assistant
product.description: An AI-driven chatbot that provides IT support by troubleshooting issues and delivering tailored IT resources based on device analytics.

product.name: Electric AI-Powered IT Platform
product.description: An AI-powered platform that automates IT and HR workflows, including employee access, device management, security, and helpdesk support.
